paths: postgresql database relational_design_lab_<run id>, named in starter/target/lab-database.txt while a run owns it
cleanup.notes: Each test run creates a uniquely named database relational_design_lab_<12 hex characters> on the learner's local server, records its name in starter/target/lab-database.txt, and drops only that database when the run finishes; it never drops a database it did not create. After an interrupted run, drop the database named in starter/target/lab-database.txt, then delete starter/target to remove compiled classes and test reports. Setup also downloads the pinned pgJDBC driver, JUnit and Maven plugins into the learner's local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository by default); that shared cache is kept for later labs and is not removed by cleanup.

licensing: Starter, tests and README: original work for this repository.

pgJDBC, the PostgreSQL JDBC driver (BSD-2-Clause), JUnit Jupiter and the JUnit Platform launcher (Eclipse Public License 2.0) and Apache Maven plugins (Apache License 2.0) are downloaded by Maven at setup; none is committed.
